title: Test options
description: Run project tests. Leave options unset to inherit project configuration and command defaults.

paths.title: Package paths
paths.description: Project-relative packages or directories. Leave empty for normal discovery.

framework.title: Test frameworks
framework.description: An empty selection runs every detected framework.

changed.title: Tests affected by changes
changed.description: Use local edits, or the runner changeset in CI, to select affected tests.

since.title: Changes since ref
since.description: Compare against a ref's merge-base plus local edits. HEAD selects local changes; staged selects the index.

changed-files.title: Explicit changed files
changed-files.description: Union these workdir-relative files with the selected changeset.

recursive.title: Discover subdirectories
recursive.description: Recursively discover packages. Leave untouched to inherit configuration.

baseline.title: Baseline results
baseline.description: Previous results JSON used to report only new failures.

failed.title: Previous failing run
failed.description: Previous results JSON used to select failed tests.

pr.title: Failed PR checks
pr.description: PR reference whose Gavel CI artifacts select failed tests.

fixtures.title: Discover fixture tests
fixtures.description: Leave untouched to inherit fixtures.enabled. Disabling clears explicit fixture globs.

fixture-files.title: Fixture globs
fixture-files.description: Overrides configured fixture discovery patterns for this run.

cache.title: Reuse passing packages
cache.description: Skip packages whose content fingerprint matches their last passing run.

concurrency.title: Package concurrency
concurrency.description: Zero selects the automatic bounded default. Leave unset to inherit configuration.

nodes.title: Ginkgo parallel nodes
nodes.description: Only applies to Ginkgo: -1 is automatic, zero uses the default, positive values choose a node count.

lint.title: Run lint alongside tests
lint.description: Disabling clears the per-linter deadline override.

lint-timeout.title: Per-linter timeout
lint-timeout.description: For example 5m. Leave unset to inherit configured lint deadlines.

test-timeout.title: Per-package timeout
test-timeout.description: For example 10m. Leave unset to inherit configured package deadlines.

timeout.title: Whole-run timeout
timeout.description: For example 20m. Leave unset to inherit the configured deadline, otherwise twenty minutes.

bench.title: Go benchmark filter
bench.description: Regular expression selecting benchmarks; a dot runs all benchmarks.

extra-args.title: Runner arguments
extra-args.description: Additional arguments broadcast to every selected test runner.

skip-hooks.title: Skip pre/post hooks
skip-hooks.description: Leave untouched for the command's environment-dependent hook policy.

dry-run.title: Preview test selection
dry-run.description: Show what would run without executing tests.
